spans.s: --an अक्षरादेवी, killed पुण्ड्रकेतु, a commander of भण्ड. Br. IV. १९. ५८; २५. ९७; ३७. ३४.

--a son of Aditi, and an आदित्य.
1: भा.

; १७१. ५६; वा. ६६. ६६; Vi. I. १५. १३०.
Presented पृथु with a good chariot.
2: भा. IV. १५. १७.
His wife was रचना, [page२-056+ ४९] and sons were Sannivasa and विश्वरूप (s.v.);
3: Ib.

. (whole).
was propitiated by An- giras for blessing चित्राक्ष with a son.
5: Ib. VI. १४. २७.
His con- templation.
6: Ib. XI. १५. २०.
The name of the Sun in the month of इष (आश्विन).
7: Ib. XII. ११. ४३. वा. ५२. २०; Vi.

. ४०; १०. १६.
(माघ and फाल्गुन) (वा। प्। and वि। प्।) Fought with शम्बर in the देवासुर war.
8: Ib. XI. १२. 5; VIII. १०. २९.
Out of the तेजस् came विष्णु's cakra, Indra's vajra, and Rudra's शूलम्; all limbs except the feet of Vivasvan were operated upon, and hence feet अमन्गल and not to be worshipped; pre- sented कुमार with a hen that could assume any form at will.
9: M. १

(I)--one of the four sons of शुक्र;
1: Br.
(III)--the son of Bhauvana and दूषणा. His queen was विरोचना, and their son विरजा. भा. V. १५. १५. Br. II. १४. ७०. वा. ३३. ५९. [page२-057+ २१]
(IV)--a name of वृत्र. भा. III. १९. २५. M. १७३. १८.
(I)--an architect of Gods; he built द्वारवति for कृष्ण. भा. X. ६९. 7.
